import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score

X=np.loadtxt('data/shops_daily.csv',delimiter=',',skiprows=1)
sc=StandardScaler(); Xs=sc.fit_transform(X)
print('shape',X.shape)
for k in range(1,11):
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=0).fit(Xs)
    sil='NA' if k==1 else round(silhouette_score(Xs,km.labels_),4)
    print('k',k,'inertia',round(km.inertia_,1),'sil',sil)
print('---GMM BIC---')
for k in range(1,11):
    g=GaussianMixture(n_components=k,covariance_type='full',random_state=0).fit(Xs)
    print('k',k,'bic',round(g.bic(Xs),1),'aic',round(g.aic(Xs),1))
PY

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
X=np.loadtxt('data/shops_daily.csv',delimiter=',',skiprows=1)
Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
p=PCA().fit(Xs)

print('cumulative', np.round(np.cumsum(p.explained_variance_ratio_),4))

# check kmeans on first 2 pcs
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
for d in [2,3,4,8]:
    for k in range(2,8):
        Zd=Z[:,:d]
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=0).fit(Zd)
        print('dims',d,'k',k,'sil',round(silhouette_score(Zd,km.labels_),4))

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
X=np.loadtxt('data/shops_daily.csv',delimiter=',',skiprows=1)
Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
# stability: run kmeans multiple seeds, compute ARI between
from sklearn.metrics import adjusted_rand_score
for k in [9,10,11]:
    labels=[]
    for seed in range(5):
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=seed).fit(Xs)
        labels.append(km.labels_)
    aris=[]
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(i+1,5):
            aris.append(adjusted_rand_score(labels[i],labels[j]))
    print('k',k,'mean ARI across seeds',round(np.mean(aris),4))
# Gap statistic
def gap(X,kmax=12,B=10,seed=0):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    mins=X.min(axis=0); maxs=X.max(axis=0)
    gaps=[]
    for k in range(1,kmax+1):
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=0).fit(X)
        wk=np.log(km.inertia_)
        wkb=[]
        for b in range(B):
            Xr=rng.uniform(mins,maxs,size=X.shape)
            kmr=KMeans(n_clusters=k,n_init=10,random_state=0).fit(Xr)
            wkb.append(np.log(kmr.inertia_))
        gaps.append(np.mean(wkb)-wk)
    return gaps
gaps=gap(Xs)
for k,g in enumerate(gaps,1):
    print('gap k',k,round(g,4))
